trigger: powershell.exe started with an -EncodedCommand argument on workstation WS-114.
initial_evidence: WS-114 is assigned to a user in the finance department
No software deployment was scheduled for WS-114 today

Q1.description: Identify the parent process of powershell.exe

Q2.description: Decode the encoded command and classify its content

Q3.description: Check outbound connections from WS-114 in the 5 minutes after execution

Q4.description: Count PowerShell executions on WS-114 in the past 30 days

Q5.description: Check whether the logged-on user has local administrator rights

trigger: 347 failed Kerberos authentications for account svc_backup within 20 minutes.
initial_evidence: svc_backup is a service account without interactive logon rights
No successful logons for svc_backup occurred in the alert window

Q1.description: Count distinct source hosts for the failed logons

Q2.description: Search scheduled tasks on the source host that run as svc_backup

Q3.description: Compare failed-logon volume with the 30-day baseline for svc_backup

Q4.description: Check failed logons against other accounts from the same source hosts

Q5.description: Check whether the svc_backup password was changed in the last 14 days

Q6.description: Check the time of day of the failed logons

trigger: File server FS-07 has sent about 50 MB over HTTPS to one external IP address every 15 minutes for 6 hours.
initial_evidence: FS-07 hosts the engineering department share
The organization uses a commercial cloud backup service

Q1.description: Check whether the destination is on the approved backup vendor list

Q2.description: Search FS-07 for archive files created shortly before each transfer

Q3.description: Check the registration age of the destination domain from DNS logs

Q4.description: Check DLP logs for sensitive-content matches in files read before the transfers

Q5.description: Compare FS-07 outbound volume today with its 30-day baseline

Q6.description: Check whether the transfers use TLS

trigger: New account adm_jlee was created and added to Domain Admins at 02:14 by IT operations user r.patel.
initial_evidence: r.patel is a member of the IT operations team
No new privileged accounts were created in the previous 30 days

Q1.description: Search change management for a ticket covering the account creation

Q2.description: Check the source host of r.patel's session when the account was created

Q3.description: Review adm_jlee activity since creation for logons to many servers or bulk directory reads

Q4.description: Check the incident system for an open major incident at 02:14

Q5.description: Check whether the creation happened outside business hours

Q6.description: Check whether adm_jlee follows the naming convention for admin accounts

trigger: About 12,000 files on share FS-02 were renamed within 9 minutes by account svc_sync, all with a new .lkd extension.
initial_evidence: svc_sync is used by the file synchronization tool
A storage migration project is planned for this quarter

Q1.description: Measure the content entropy of a sample of renamed files

Q2.description: Check whether canary files on the share were modified

Q3.description: Search change management for a migration scheduled at this time

Q4.description: Search the share for new text or HTML files created in each folder

Q5.description: Compare the rename volume with svc_sync's nightly baseline

Q6.description: Check whether svc_sync's password was used from its usual host

trigger: A finance user granted a newly seen third-party app, InvoiceFlow, the Mail.ReadWrite and Files.ReadWrite.All permissions.
initial_evidence: The app was first seen in the tenant today
The user approved the consent prompt themselves

Q1.description: Search procurement records for a purchase of InvoiceFlow

Q2.description: Check whether the app's publisher is verified

Q3.description: Check the location and network of the sign-in that granted consent

Q4.description: Check the user's mailbox for new forwarding or deletion rules after consent

Q5.description: Assess whether the granted permissions are high privilege

Q6.description: Count other users who consented to the same app
